purpose: Permit checksum-verified one-pass processing when a full local mirror cannot fit, while retaining immutable full-resolution remote objects for locus follow-up.

retain: remote object snapshot with version-pinned URL
official expected checksum and compressed byte count
observed MD5 and SHA-256 streaming receipt
HapMap3 LDSC input and munging log

full_resolution_followup.retention_mode: official S3 versionId-pinned bgzip object plus versionId-pinned tabix index
full_resolution_followup.locus_retrieval: retrieve the complete dense locus slice from the exact locked source only after a locus is selected by the frozen follow-up protocol
full_resolution_followup.failure_policy: if the exact remote version or checksum cannot be recovered, dense follow-up is BLOCKED_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; never substitute another release

scientific_boundaries: Streaming changes storage mechanics only; the 100 traits and their order remain locked.
The source, allele, ancestry, build, QC, h2, rg, and FDR contracts are unchanged.
HapMap3 output is sufficient only for global LDSC; it is never reused as dense locus evidence.
No extension result may be inspected until its source checksum and harmonization receipt pass.
